query: SELECT c.id AS "id!", c.clip_url AS "clip_url!" FROM twitch_clips_social_media c JOIN social_media_category k ON k.category_key = c.category_key WHERE c.discarded_at IS NULL AND k.enrichment_enabled AND COALESCE(c.upload_local_path, c.local_file_path) IS NULL AND c.clip_url IS NOT NULL AND c.clip_url <> '' ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT $1
